enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Breathe in and out. Move arm. Move leg. Remain still. Air conditioner is on.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth, and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face with water. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Pick up clothes. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Remove toast. Butter toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat toast. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag and checking phone for schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up work bag. Open bag. Place laptop inside. Place stethoscope inside. Place notebook inside. Place pens inside. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Scroll through schedule. Check appointments. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Turn key. Start engine. Press gas pedal. Drive. Stop at red light. Wait. Press gas pedal. Turn steering wheel. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance. Open door. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Talk to patient. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk to next patient room. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking lunch break at hospital cafeteria
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Place food on tray. Pick up drink. Place drink on tray. Walk to cashier. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Wipe mouth with napkin. Pick up tray. Return tray to designated area. Walk out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Check patient's vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Talk to patient. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk to next patient room. Write reports. Attend meeting. Consult with colleagues. Review patient files. Walk to another patient room. Provide care.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Turn key. Start engine. Press gas pedal. Drive. Stop at red light. Wait. Press gas pedal. Turn steering wheel. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to home entrance. Open door. Walk inside.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up kitchen and relaxing on sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Pick up dishes. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with sponge. Wipe stove. Throw away trash. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and using computer with air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Type on keyboard. Browse internet. Check email. Watch TV. Adjust air conditioner. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Wash face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Breathe in and out. Move arm. Move leg. Remain still. Air conditioner is on.
